last_codex_audit.note: Round 1 of Checkpoint 3's own audit -- 2 real High findings: (1) nutrients.ts's netRequirement re-derived its figure from already-rounded requirement.value/organicApplication.offset* instead of the actual unrounded remainingN/P/K fed to allocatePurchasedProducts, so it could materially disagree with the real product blend at a rounding boundary -- fixed by rounding remainingN/P/K themselves. (2) FarmFertiliserPurchaseRequirementCard.tsx decided whether a product line had anything left to buy using the rounded remainingTotalTonnes figure, so a real sub-5kg farm-wide remainder could be silently dropped or reported as 'nothing left to buy' -- fixed by adding an exact remainingTotalKg field to FarmFertiliserPurchaseRequirementLine and gating on that instead. Full account: IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md's own 'Checkpoint 3 -- Codex audit round 1' entry. Round 2 pending.
